run_brute_force: run a parallelized brute force search of all action combinations up to a given episode length in CompilerGym
run_BruteForceProducer: run a producer thread that enumerates all action combinations and writes chunks to a queue for workers
run_BruteForceWorker: run a worker thread that reads action sequence chunks and evaluates their incremental rewards in a CompilerGym environment
run_grouper: run the grouper utility to split an iterable into fixed-size chunks padded with None values
run_main: run the CLI entry point to execute a brute force action space search with configurable benchmark and episode length
